mapper.sql: id, team_id, user_id, user_name, content, is_anonymous, create_time, delete_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `team_feedback`( team_id, user_id, user_name, content, is_anonymous, create_time )VALUES( #{teamId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{content}, #{isAnonymous}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `team_feedback` WHERE team_id = #{teamId} AND delete_time IS NULL ORDER BY create_time DESC
